Backward-incompatible changes

Acme Sprinkler

The acme_sprinkler.run_zone action now takes minutes, not seconds. Update your automations that call acme_sprinkler.run_zone.

(acme_sprinkler docs)

Acme Weather

The sensor.acme_weather_rain entity is replaced by sensor.acme_weather_precipitation.

(acme_weather docs)
